items.q: the first edition of that band had Don Frye as the piano player... you and Clarence Palmer the vocalist

ctx.x: They were all, because a lot of the guys on there.... Not a lot of them but the later, the first edition of that band had Don Frye as the piano player. Let's see who else was on there. There was Frankie, and I guess he did the arrangements, right?
